description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the MergeSortedAsPair component of an Akka Streams-based system, verifying merging behavior of two sorted streams and handling various edge cases.

classes.name: MergeSortedAsPairTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the MergeSortedAsPair Akka Streams component

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before all tests.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: testMergeSortedResult
methods.description: Verifies merging of two sorted streams produces the expected combined sorted list.

methods.name: forIdenticalSources
methods.description: Tests merging of identical sources yields correct pairs.

methods.name: testBehaviorSpecificationByMergeSortOnExample
methods.description: Compares the mergeSorted result with a reference merge sort implementation to verify correctness.

methods.name: testBehaviorSpecificationByMergeSortOnEarlyExhaustion
methods.description: Verifies behavior when one source is exhausted early.

methods.name: testIdenticalStartAndEnd
methods.description: Tests merging when streams start and end with identical values and streams produce data in parallel.

methods.name: mergeEmptySources
methods.description: Checks handling of empty sources, ensuring result with `Integer.MAX_VALUE` placeholders.

methods.name: testUpstreamFailure
methods.description: Verifies error propagation when an upstream source fails.

methods.name: testSourcesDisjointInTimeWithTheEarlierSourceExhaustedFirst
methods.description: Verifies correct merging behavior when sources are disjoint in time with the first source ending first.

methods.name: testSourcesDisjointInTimeWithTheLaterSourceExhaustedFirst
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the second source ends before the first.

methods.name: materializeTestProbes
methods.description: Sets up test probes for interacting with source streams during tests.

methods.name: equivalentOfMergeSortedUnderTest
methods.description: Converts the Pair output into a flattened sorted list, used for comparison.

methods.name: mergeSortedAsPair
methods.description: Creates a source of pairs from two sorted sources, using internal merging logic.

methods.name: mergeSortedAsPairWithMat
methods.description: Creates the graph with materialized pair sources.

methods.name: runWithMergeSortedAsPair
methods.description: Runs the merge process and collects results into a list.

methods.name: runSource
methods.description: Executes an Akka Stream source and collects the emitted elements into a list.
